events.title: Alliance for Real Change (Kenya) is founded
events.summary: The Alliance for Real Change (ARC) is a Kenyan political party founded in 2010 but registered in 2012, by Mohammed Abduba Dida a candidate in the March 2013 Kenyan Presidential election.

events.title: City Council Cemetery Land Scandal
events.summary: The City Council Cemetery Land Scandal is a scandal that in March 2010, resulted in Kenyan Deputy Prime Minister Musalia Mudavadi coming under investigation by the Kenya Anti-Corruption Commission over a Sh283 million cemetery incidence of land fraud at the Nairobi City Council. Commission officials said that they wanted to establish whether the minister was party to the fraud in which the Council bought land valued at Sh24 million for nearly Sh300 million.
events.source_name: Wikipedia: City Council Cemetery Land Scandal

events.title: Embassy Property Purchase Scandal
events.summary: The Embassy Property Purchase Scandal is a scandal that resulted in the Kenyan Minister for Foreign Affairs Moses Wetangula leaving his post. Wetangula left his ministerial post on October 27, 2010, due to ongoing investigation on his alleged involvement in the Kenyan Tokyo embassy scandal.

events.title: iHub opens in Nairobi
events.summary: iHub is a technology innovation hub and hackerspace located in Nairobi, Kenya. Founded in March 2010 by Erik Hersman, Juliana Rotich, David Kobia, and Ory Okolloh, it served as an open workspace and incubator for technologists, investors, researchers, and software developers.

events.title: Prevention of Organized Crimes Act
events.summary: The Prevention of Organized Crimes Act, Act No. 6 of 2010, is a Kenyan Act of Parliament aimed at the suppression of organized crime in Kenya.
events.source_name: Wikipedia: Prevention of Organized Crimes Act 2010

events.title: The Endorois case
events.summary: Centre for Minority Rights Development (Kenya) and Minority Rights Group International on Behalf of Endorois Welfare Council v. Kenya, also known as the Endorois case, was a ruling of the African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights (ACHPR) surrounding the removal of the Endorois people from Lake Bogoria by the government of Kenya.

events.title: The International Criminal Court investigates Kenya
events.summary: The International Criminal Court investigation in Kenya or the situation in the Republic of Kenya was an investigation by the International Criminal Court (ICC) into the responsibility for the 2007–2008 post-election violence in Kenya. The 2007–2008 crisis followed the presidential election that was held on 27 December 2007.
events.source_name: Wikipedia: International Criminal Court investigation in Kenya

events.title: Kenya gazetted the new media law, despite being criticised by the media for limiting the freedom of press
events.summary: Kenya gazetted the new media law, despite being criticised by the media for limiting the freedom of press.

events.title: Jamaican Muslim cleric Sheikh Abdullah al-Faisal was deported from Kenya
events.summary: Jamaican Muslim cleric Sheikh Abdullah al-Faisal was deported from Kenya. Earlier two demonstrators died when a group of youth protesting his arrest clashed with the police.

events.title: Five people died and seven injured when two lorries collided on Waiyaki Way, Westlands, Nairobi
events.summary: Five people died and seven injured when two lorries collided on Waiyaki Way, Westlands, Nairobi. Another accident occurred in Ndengelwa, Bungoma District, where a matatu and a diesel tanker collided leaving five dead and several injured.

events.title: Five workers died when a quarry collapsed in Mukangu village, Muranga District
events.summary: Five workers died when a quarry collapsed in Mukangu village, Muranga District.

events.title: The Kenyan Appellate Court orders 2007 parliamentary election votes of the Starehe Constituency to be recounted
events.summary: The Kenyan Appellate Court orders 2007 parliamentary election votes of the Starehe Constituency to be recounted. The recounting is for irregularities in the original counting, when Margaret Wanjiru won the seat beating narrowly the then incumbent MP Maina Kamanda.

events.title: The minister of transport Chirau Ali Mwakwere of PNU loses his Matuga Constituency parliamentary seat after the High Court ruled the…
events.summary: The minister of transport Chirau Ali Mwakwere of PNU loses his Matuga Constituency parliamentary seat after the High Court ruled the election not being free, fair and transparent. A by-election is to be held on a later date.

events.title: Number of permanent secretaries and other government officials are suspended by the president Mwai Kibaki due to corruption allegations…
events.summary: Number of permanent secretaries and other government officials are suspended by the president Mwai Kibaki due to corruption allegations on them. Among them is the Education PS Karega Mutahi, who had earlier admitted diverting money single-handedly from a project to another.

events.title: Prime Minister Raila Odinga suspends Minister of Agriculture William Ruto and Minister of Education Sam Ongeri alleging them on corruption
events.summary: Prime Minister Raila Odinga suspends Minister of Agriculture William Ruto and Minister of Education Sam Ongeri alleging them on corruption. Ongeri has admitted diverting school infrastructure money to his constituency while Ruto is linked to the maize scandal.

events.title: Six kidnappers were shot dead by the police when they successfully rescued two foreigners, one Ethiopian and one Canadian in Gatundu,…
events.summary: Six kidnappers were shot dead by the police when they successfully rescued two foreigners, one Ethiopian and one Canadian in Gatundu, Thika District.

events.title: 11 people died and nearly 30 injured when a bus and a lorry collided at Ndala between Maungu and Voi along the Nairobi - Mombasa Highway
events.summary: 11 people died and nearly 30 injured when a bus and a lorry collided at Ndala between Maungu and Voi along the Nairobi - Mombasa Highway.

events.title: a new political coalition Progressive Democratic Movement (PDM) was announced by Kalonzo Musyoka, Uhuru Kenyatta, George Saitoti and…
events.summary: a new political coalition Progressive Democratic Movement (PDM) was announced by Kalonzo Musyoka, Uhuru Kenyatta, George Saitoti and other leaders from PNU-affiliated parties.

events.title: Administration Police officers shot seven taxi drivers dead in Dagoretti, Nairobi
events.summary: Administration Police officers shot seven taxi drivers dead in Dagoretti, Nairobi.

events.title: Six people died when a matatu and a lorry collided along the Sagana-Makutano road
events.summary: Six people died when a matatu and a lorry collided along the Sagana-Makutano road.

events.title: Nine people died in traffic accident at Kithini village, near Machakos
events.summary: Nine people died in traffic accident at Kithini village, near Machakos.

events.title: Two people died when a light aircraft crashed at landing Wilson Airport in Nairobi
events.summary: Two people died when a light aircraft crashed at landing Wilson Airport in Nairobi.

events.title: 24 people died in a traffic accident at Katunguma Bridge along Nairobi-Mombasa highway
events.summary: 24 people died in a traffic accident at Katunguma Bridge along Nairobi-Mombasa highway.

events.title: The Kenyan parliament passes the draft constitution, paving the way for the 2010 constitutional referendum to be held on July 2, 2010
events.summary: The Kenyan parliament passes the draft constitution, paving the way for the 2010 constitutional referendum to be held on July 2, 2010.

events.title: George Thuo (PNU) loses his parliamentary seat after a court nullified the 2007 election results of Juja Constituency citing irregularities
events.summary: George Thuo (PNU) loses his parliamentary seat after a court nullified the 2007 election results of Juja Constituency citing irregularities. Margaret Wanjiru (ODM) also risk losing her seat after a Starehe Constituency vote recount indicates that Maina Kamanda (PNU) won the election with a clear margin.

events.title: 12 people died when a bus collided with a trailer along the Naivasha-Mai Mahiu Road
events.summary: 12 people died when a bus collided with a trailer along the Naivasha-Mai Mahiu Road.

events.title: Dick Wathika (PNU) is set to lose his parliamentary seat after a court nullified the 2007 election results of Makadara Constituency…
events.summary: Dick Wathika (PNU) is set to lose his parliamentary seat after a court nullified the 2007 election results of Makadara Constituency citing irregularities.

events.title: Manson Nyamweya of Ford-People won the South Mugirango Constituency parliamentary by-election, beating the previous MP James Omingo…
events.summary: Manson Nyamweya of Ford-People won the South Mugirango Constituency parliamentary by-election, beating the previous MP James Omingo Magara, now representing People's Democratic Party (PDP).

events.title: A bomb blast at the Uhuru Park in Nairobi kills six people and lefts over 100 people injured
events.summary: A bomb blast at the Uhuru Park in Nairobi kills six people and lefts over 100 people injured. The blast targeted a "NO" campaign rally for the forthcoming constitutional referendum.

events.title: Chirau Ali Mwakwere (PNU) retained Matuga Constituency parliamentary seat in a by-election
events.summary: Chirau Ali Mwakwere (PNU) retained Matuga Constituency parliamentary seat in a by-election. His election in 2007 had been nullified by high court in February 2010.

events.title: The EASSy undersea cable lands
events.summary: The Eastern Africa Submarine Cable System (EASSy) is an undersea fibre optic cable system connecting countries in Eastern Africa to the rest of the world. EASSy runs from Mtunzini in South Africa to Port Sudan in Sudan, with landing points in nine countries and is connected to at least ten landlocked countries — which will no longer have to rely on satellite Internet access to carry voice and data services.

events.title: A border clash with al-Shabaab
events.summary: The 2010 Kenya–Al-Shabaab border clash occurred on July 20, 2010, when gunmen from the Al-Shabaab terrorist group attacked a Kenyan border patrol along the border area in Liboi, Lagdera. There was a subsequent fierce exchange of fire between the two sides leading to the deaths of two militia and the wounding of one Kenyan officer.

events.title: The 2010 Constitution
events.summary: The Constitution of Kenya is the supreme law of the Republic of Kenya. There have been three significant versions of Kenya's constitution, with the most recent being the one promulgated in 2010.

events.title: A referendum is held on the Proposed Constitution of Kenya, which was then ratified by a 68.55% majority, paving way for promulgation…
events.summary: A referendum is held on the Proposed Constitution of Kenya, which was then ratified by a 68.55% majority, paving way for promulgation on 27 August 2010.

events.title: Kenyan constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum was held in Kenya on 4 August 2010. Voters were asked whether they approved of a proposed new constitution, which had been passed by the National Assembly on 1 April 2010.

events.title: Three parliamentary by-elections were held
events.summary: Three parliamentary by-elections were held. Margaret Wanjiru retained her Starehe Constituency seat beating Maina Kamanda (PNU).

events.title: Higher education minister William Ruto was suspended due to ongoing investigations on his alleged involvement in a forest land…
events.summary: Higher education minister William Ruto was suspended due to ongoing investigations on his alleged involvement in a forest land corruption case.

events.title: The Kirinyaga Central Constituency MP John Ngata Kariuki loses his seat following a declaration by High court that he was wrongfully…
events.summary: The Kirinyaga Central Constituency MP John Ngata Kariuki loses his seat following a declaration by High court that he was wrongfully declared the winner at the 2007 parliamentary elections.

events.title: Nairobi Mayor Geoffrey Majiwa steps aside after being charged for his alleged involvement in a cemetery land corruption scandal
events.summary: Nairobi Mayor Geoffrey Majiwa steps aside after being charged for his alleged involvement in a cemetery land corruption scandal.

events.title: Foreign Minister Moses Wetangula resigned due to allegations of him being involved in an Embassy corruption scandal
events.summary: Foreign Minister Moses Wetangula resigned due to allegations of him being involved in an Embassy corruption scandal. His Permanent Secretary Thuita Mwangi resigned also.

events.title: The Truth Justice and Reconciliation Commission chairman Bethuel Kiplagat steps aside to allow a tribunal to investigate his conduct
events.summary: The Truth Justice and Reconciliation Commission chairman Bethuel Kiplagat steps aside to allow a tribunal to investigate his conduct.

events.title: Peter Karanja, a jealous Administration Police officer, killed 10 people in a shooting spree in Siakago
events.summary: Peter Karanja, a jealous Administration Police officer, killed 10 people in a shooting spree in Siakago.

events.title: 10 people die when a bus veers off-road in Ngarariga, near Nairobi
events.summary: 10 people die when a bus veers off-road in Ngarariga, near Nairobi.

events.title: 2011–2014 terrorist attacks in Kenya
events.summary: From late 2011 to 2014, Kenya experienced an upsurge in violent terrorist attacks. Kenyan government officials asserted that many of the murders and blasts were carried out by al-Shabaab in retaliation for Operation Linda Nchi, a coordinated military mission between the Somali military and Kenyan military that began in October 2011, when troops from Kenya crossed the border into the conflict zones of southern Somalia.

events.title: 2011 Nairobi pipeline fire
events.summary: The 2011 Nairobi pipeline fire was caused by an explosion secondary to a fuel spill in the Kenyan capital Nairobi on 12 September 2011. Approximately 100 people were killed in the fire and at least 116 others were hospitalized with varying degrees of burns.

events.title: Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission
events.summary: The Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission (IEBC) is an independent regulatory agency that was founded in 2011 under the Constitution of Kenya. The Commission is responsible for conducting or supervising referendums and elections to any elective body or office established by the Constitution, and any other elections as prescribed by an Act of Parliament.
events.source_name: Wikipedia: Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission

events.title: Kenya National Union of Nurses and Midwives is founded
events.summary: The Kenya National Union of Nurses and Midwives (KNUNM) is a Kenyan trade union established to represent Registered Nurses, Midwives, Community Health Nurses and allied workers. It was founded in 2011 and recognized in 2013 under the Labour Relations Act of 2007 to represent nurses in labour negotiations with public and private institutions .
events.source_name: Wikipedia: Kenya National Union of Nurses and Midwives

events.title: Kibabii University is founded
events.summary: Kibabii University is a public university in Kenya located in Bungoma County along Bungoma-Chwele highway approximately 8km from Bungoma Town centre. Previously a constituent college of Masinde Muliro University of Science and Technology, the university was granted its Charter by President Kenyatta in November 2015.

events.title: Kirinyaga University is founded
events.summary: Kirinyaga University is a public university situated in Kutus Kerugoya in Kirinyaga County, Kenya.along the Sagana-Embu Highway approximately 115km northeast of Nairobi.

events.title: Unity Party of Kenya is founded
events.summary: The Unity Party of Kenya (UPK) is a political party of Kenya. It was formed in 2011 and was among 59 officially registered under the Political Parties Act in 2011 and 2012.

events.title: University of Embu is founded
events.summary: The University of Embu (UoEm) is a public research university located in Embu County, Kenya. Established in 2011 as a constituent college of the University of Nairobi and chartered as a full-fledged university in 2016.

events.title: A delegation led by Kenyan Prime Minister Raila Odinga fails to solve the 2010–2011 Ivorian crisis
events.summary: A delegation led by Kenyan Prime Minister Raila Odinga fails to solve the 2010–2011 Ivorian crisis.

events.title: The Minister of Industrialisation Henry Kosgey gives up his cabinet post
events.summary: The Minister of Industrialisation Henry Kosgey gives up his cabinet post. Kosgey is subject to corruption investigations and also is one of six Kenyans charged by the International Criminal Court.

events.title: Simon Mbugua of PNU loses his Kamukunji Constituency parliamentary seat as the 2007 election result was annulled by a court in January 2011
events.summary: Simon Mbugua of PNU loses his Kamukunji Constituency parliamentary seat as the 2007 election result was annulled by a court in January 2011.

events.title: The Commission on the Implementation of Constitution declares unconstitutional the recent naming of Chief Justice and other top…
events.summary: The Commission on the Implementation of Constitution declares unconstitutional the recent naming of Chief Justice and other top juridical posts by the President Mwai Kibaki.

events.title: Ten people die as a bus collides with a truck in Sachangwan along the Nakuru-Eldoret highway
events.summary: Ten people die as a bus collides with a truck in Sachangwan along the Nakuru-Eldoret highway.

events.title: Nine people die as a matatu and a bus collide at the Matunda bridge along the Kitale-Webuye road
events.summary: Nine people die as a matatu and a bus collide at the Matunda bridge along the Kitale-Webuye road.

events.title: Joseph Gitari of PNU won the Kirinyaga Central Constituency parliamentary by-election
events.summary: Joseph Gitari of PNU won the Kirinyaga Central Constituency parliamentary by-election.

events.title: Bonny Khalwale of New Ford Kenya loses his Ikolomani Constituency parliamentary seat as the High Court cites electoral malpractice in…
events.summary: Bonny Khalwale of New Ford Kenya loses his Ikolomani Constituency parliamentary seat as the High Court cites electoral malpractice in the 2007 election.

events.title: Thousands of residents flee Mandera town as fighting between Somali militia escalates in the area
events.summary: Thousands of residents flee Mandera town as fighting between Somali militia escalates in the area.

events.title: The International Criminal Court summons six previously named Kenyans to appear at the court in the Hague on April 7, 2011
events.summary: The International Criminal Court summons six previously named Kenyans to appear at the court in the Hague on April 7, 2011. Meanwhile, a faction of Kenyan government, including President Mwai Kibaki and Vice President Kalonzo Musyoka are calling for ICC to drop the cases.

events.title: 2011 East Africa drought
events.summary: Occurring between July 2011 and mid-2012, a severe drought affected the entire East African region. Said to be "the worst in 60 years", the drought caused a severe food crisis across Somalia, Djibouti, Ethiopia and Kenya that threatened the livelihood of 9.5 million people.

events.title: Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission
events.summary: The Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission, abbreviated as the EACC, is a Kenyan government agency established to combat and prevent corruption in the country. The commission operates through direct law enforcement and preventive measures in addition to the education and promotion of standards and best practices in integrity and ethics in Kenya.

events.title: Over 100 people die in a pipeline fire in Sinai slum, Nairobi
events.summary: Over 100 people die in a pipeline fire in Sinai slum, Nairobi.

events.title: Kenyan Defense Forces enter southern Somalia as part of Operation Linda Nchi
events.summary: Kenyan Defense Forces enter southern Somalia as part of Operation Linda Nchi. The KDF intervened to provide a buffer between terrorist group Al-Shaabab and the Kenyan Border.

events.title: Operation Linda Nchi
events.summary: Operation Linda Nchi (Swahili: Linda Nchi, lit. 'Protect the Country') was the Kenya Defence Forces' invasion of southern Somalia beginning in 2011.

events.title: Nakuru County Peace Accord
events.summary: The Nakuru County Peace Accord (or “Rift Valley Peace Accord”) refers to the peace agreement signed on 19 August 2012 between elders of the Agikuyu (see also Kikuyu) and Kalenjin communities as well as other ethnic groups of Kenya. The agreement was signed following a 16-month-long peace process led by the National Cohesion and Integration Commission (NCIC) to address sources of ethnic conflict and a history of violence in the rift valley region of Kenya.

events.title: National Land Commission
events.summary: The National Land Commission of Kenya is an independent government commission whose establishment was provided for by the Constitution of Kenya to, amongst other things, manage public land on behalf of the national and county governments, initiate investigations into present or historical land injustices and recommend appropriate redress, and monitor and have oversight responsibilities over land use planning throughout the country. NLC was officially established under The National Land Commission Act of 2012.

events.title: Restore and Build Kenya is founded
events.summary: Restore and Build Kenya (RBK) is a Kenyan political party launched in April 2012 by former Permanent Secretary Professor James ole Kiyiapi as part of his campaign to become the fourth President of Kenya.

events.title: The Party of Development and Reforms, later the UDA, is founded
events.summary: The United Democratic Alliance (UDA) is the current ruling political party in Kenya. Their slogan is "Kazi ni Kazi" (A job is a job; All hustles matter) and their symbol is a wheelbarrow.

events.title: 2012 Kenya Police helicopter crash
events.summary: On 10 June 2012, an aviation accident occurred involving a Kenya Police helicopter. The Eurocopter AS350 crashed on a hill, killing all six people on board.

events.title: 6 people died in the police helicopter crash
events.summary: 6 people died in the police helicopter crash.

events.title: The United States embassy in Nairobi held what was believed to be the first ever LGBT pride event in Kenya
events.summary: The United States embassy in Nairobi held what was believed to be the first ever LGBT pride event in Kenya. A public affairs officer at the embassy said, "The U.S. government for its part has made it clear that the advancement of human rights for LGBT people is central to our human rights policies around the world and to the realization of our foreign policy goals".

events.title: 52 people died during the Tana River District clashes
events.summary: 52 people died during the Tana River District clashes.

events.title: Baragoi clashes
events.summary: In November 2012, a series of ethnic clashes between the Samburu and Turkana tribes of Kenya's Samburu County resulted in the deaths of at least 46 people including police officers sent to quell the violence.

events.title: The CORD coalition is formed
events.summary: The Coalition for Reforms and Democracy (CORD) was a coalition of multiple political parties, built around the triumvirate of Raila Odinga, Kalonzo Musyoka, and Moses Wetangula, to contest the 2013 Kenyan general election. The members of the coalition are the Orange Democratic Movement, the Wiper Democratic Movement, FORD–Kenya, Kenya Social Congress, KADU–Asili, the Peoples Democratic Party, the Mkenya Solidarity Movement, Chama Cha Uzalendo, the Muungano Party, the United Democratic Movement, Chama Cha Mwananchi, and the Federal Party of Kenya Following the hotly-contested elections that saw the Jubilee Alliance win, CORD filed a petition contesting the results.
events.source_name: Wikipedia: Coalition for Reforms and Democracy

events.title: 2013 Kenyan presidential election petition
events.summary: The Kenya Presidential Election Petition of 2013 was an election petition aiming to declare the Kenya presidential election 2013 invalid. The Petition was filed at the Supreme Court of Kenya on 16 March 2013.

events.title: Karatina University is founded
events.summary: Karatina University is a chartered public university in the town of Karatina, in central Kenya.

events.title: Maasai Mara University is founded
events.summary: Maasai Mara University (MMU), (formerly Narok University College, Moi University Narok Town Campus), is a public university located in Narok County, Kenya.

events.title: Multimedia University of Kenya is founded
events.summary: The Multimedia University of Kenya (MMU) is a public University. It is located along Magadi Road, in Karen Ward, Langata sub-county, Nairobi County.

events.title: South Eastern Kenya University is founded
events.summary: South Eastern Kenya University (SEKU) is a public university with its main campus located in Kwa Vonza, Kitui County, Kenya. It was formerly South Eastern University College "SEUCO", a constituent college of The University of Nairobi prior to its award of Charter in 2013.

events.title: Technical University of Mombasa is founded
events.summary: Technical University of Mombasa (TUM) is a public university located in the coastal city of Mombasa. It is amongst the oldest institutions of higher learning in Kenya.

events.title: Amani Alliance is founded
events.summary: The Amani Coalition was a political party alliance in Kenya.

events.title: Jubilee Alliance is founded
events.summary: The Jubilee Alliance was a political alliance in Kenya.

events.title: Provinces give way to 47 counties
events.summary: Kenya's former provinces were replaced by a system of 47 counties in 2013, following the general elections held on March 4, 2013, which fully implemented the devolved government system outlined in the Constitution of Kenya 2010.

events.title: 2013 Kenyan general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Kenya on 4 March 2013. Voters elected the President, members of the National Assembly and newly formed Senate.

events.title: The 11th Parliament opens
events.summary: The 11th Parliament of Kenya was the meeting of the legislative branch of the national government of Kenya, which began on 28 March 2013. It is the first Parliament to incorporate the structural reforms laid out in the 2010 Constitution.

events.title: Uhuru Kenyatta becomes president
events.summary: The presidency of Uhuru Kenyatta began on 9 April 2013 after being sworn in as 4th president of Kenya and ended on 13 September 2022 after handing over to William Ruto. He succeeded Mwai Kibaki.

events.title: Death of Mutula Kilonzo
events.summary: On 27 April 2013, Kenyan politician and lawyer Mutula Kilonzo, who was serving as the first Senator of Makueni County, died at his ranch in Maanzoni, Machakos County. A requiem mass was held at the Nairobi Baptist Church in Nairobi on 8 May, followed by his burial at his home village in Makueni County, in line with his wishes.

events.title: Westgate shopping mall shooting
events.summary: On 21 September 2013, four gunmen attacked the Westgate shopping mall, an upmarket mall in Nairobi, Kenya. There are conflicting reports about the number killed in the attack, since part of the mall collapsed due to a fire that started during the siege.

events.title: al-Shabaab Islamic militants attack the Westgate shopping mall in Nairobi, Kenya, killing at least 62 civilians and wounding over 170
events.summary: al-Shabaab Islamic militants attack the Westgate shopping mall in Nairobi, Kenya, killing at least 62 civilians and wounding over 170.

events.title: The Beyond Zero campaign
events.summary: The Beyond Zero Campaign is an initiative launched by Kenya's First Lady, Margaret Gakuo Kenyatta. Its goals are to improve maternal and child health in Kenya, and to reduce new HIV infections among children.

events.title: Nairobi police station bombing
events.summary: Nairobi police station bombing.

events.title: Killing of Satao, one of the country's largest elephants by poisoned arrow
events.summary: Killing of Satao, one of the country's largest elephants by poisoned arrow.

events.title: Skyward International Aviation Fokker 50
events.summary: Aircraft crash in July 2014 at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport.

events.title: 2014 Lamu attacks
events.summary: On the night of 5–6 July 2014, heavily armed men attacked the Kenyan villages of Hindi in Lamu County and Gamba in Tana River County. At least 29 people were killed in the attacks.

events.title: Unidentified gunmen kill at least 20 police officers in an ambush in Turkana County
events.summary: Unidentified gunmen kill at least 20 police officers in an ambush in Turkana County.

events.title: An assault on a police barracks by suspected members of the Mombasa Republican Council separatist group leaves one officer and six…
events.summary: An assault on a police barracks by suspected members of the Mombasa Republican Council separatist group leaves one officer and six attackers dead in Mombasa.

events.title: Kenyan police raid two mosques in Mombasa suspected of being linked to Al-Shabaab
events.summary: Kenyan police raid two mosques in Mombasa suspected of being linked to Al-Shabaab. One man is killed and over 200 are arrested.

events.title: Al-Shabaab militants hijack a bus travelling between the town of Mandera and Nairobi and execute 28 non-Muslim passengers
events.summary: Al-Shabaab militants hijack a bus travelling between the town of Mandera and Nairobi and execute 28 non-Muslim passengers.

events.title: The Red Cross says that at least 36 people may have been killed in an attack in Mandera County in northeastern Kenya
events.summary: The Red Cross says that at least 36 people may have been killed in an attack in Mandera County in northeastern Kenya. Al-Shabaab militants are believed to be responsible.

events.title: Amani National Congress is founded
events.summary: The Amani National Congress (ANC) is a social-liberal political party in Kenya. It tends to be more popular among the Luhya people.

events.title: World Trade Organization Ministerial Conference of 2015
events.summary: The Tenth World Trade Organization Ministerial Conference was held in Nairobi, Kenya from 15 to 19 December 2015. The conference was chaired by the Kenyan Foreign Affairs Minister Amina Mohamed.
events.source_name: Wikipedia: World Trade Organization Ministerial Conference of 2015

events.title: A six-story building collapse in Nairobi kills one person and leaves several others injured
events.summary: A six-story building collapse in Nairobi kills one person and leaves several others injured.

events.title: For the second day in a row a multi-story residential building in Nairobi collapses, this time an 8-story building, killing one person…
events.summary: For the second day in a row a multi-story residential building in Nairobi collapses, this time an 8-story building, killing one person with eight people still missing.

events.title: Gunmen attack Garissa University College, killing at least 140 people and wounding 65 others
events.summary: Gunmen attack Garissa University College, killing at least 140 people and wounding 65 others.

events.title: Battle of Baure
events.summary: The Battle of Baure was an Al-Shabaab attack on a Kenyan military base located next to the town of Baure, in Lamu County, Kenya.

events.title: Pope Francis visits Kenya
events.summary: Pope Francis visited Kenya from 25 to 27 November 2015. It was his first state and pastoral visit to the country and the continent of Africa at large.
events.source_name: Wikipedia: 2015 visit by Pope Francis to Kenya

events.title: In an attack on a bus travelling from Mandera to Nairobi, 2 people die and 3 are injured
events.summary: In an attack on a bus travelling from Mandera to Nairobi, 2 people die and 3 are injured. Muslim passengers protect the non-Muslim passengers by giving them headscarves and refusing to separate into groups, saying "to kill them together or leave them alone".

events.title: Jubilee Party of Kenya is founded
events.summary: The Jubilee Party of Kenya is a major political party in Kenya. It has significantly influenced the country's political landscape since its founding on 8 September 2016.

events.title: Kenya Reform Party is founded
events.summary: The Kenya Reform Party is a Kenyan political party organised around the values of creating employment, industrialisation, and security, as gears for enhancing development. The Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission fully registered it as a political party on 22 February 2016.

events.title: Battle of El Adde
events.summary: The Battle of El Adde took place on 15 January 2016. Al-Shabaab militants launched an attack on a Kenyan-run AMISOM army base in the town of El Adde, Gedo, Somalia.

events.title: Willie Kimani is killed
events.summary: Willie Kimani Kinuthia (21 April 1984 – 23 June 2016) was a Kenyan human rights lawyer that was murdered in-line of duty in one of the most prolific cases on Police Brutality in Kenya. He worked with the International Justice Mission (IJM) in Nairobi and a board member of Right Promotion Protection and also a member of the Law Society of Kenya (LSK) Before his killing, Willie had taken up a case against police officer Fredrick Leliman filed by his client Josephat Mwenda, a motorcycle 'bobaboda' operator.

events.title: The Naivasha tanker explosion
events.summary: The Naivasha traffic fireball occurred on 11 December 2016 when a small truck (allegedly a Canter) carrying explosive chemicals lost control due to an unmarked road bump and exploded on a main highway near Naivasha, Kenya. The explosion caught up 10 other vehicles including a military vehicle and killed 43 people and injuring more than 50 people, according to the Kenya National Disaster Operation Centre.

events.title: 2017 Kenyan presidential election petition
events.summary: The 2017 Kenyan presidential election petition (Presidential Election Petition 1 of 2017) was a Supreme Court of Kenya challenge to the results of the 8 August 2017 presidential election. The petition was brought forward by Raila Odinga and Kalonzo Musyoka, the National Super Alliance (NASA) candidates, challenging the legitimacy of Kenya's August 8, 2017, presidential election.

events.title: Economic Freedom Party is founded
events.summary: The Economic Freedom Party (EFP) is a left-leaning political party in Kenya that seeks to establish the economic freedom of the Kenyan people.

events.title: Kenya Medical Practitioners, Pharmacists and Dentists Union is founded
events.summary: The Kenya Medical Practitioners, Pharmacists and Dentists Union (KMPDU) is a trade union for medical doctors in Kenya. On February 13, 2017, seven union officials were jailed for a month for refusing to end their two-month strike over poor working conditions.
events.source_name: Wikipedia: Kenya Medical Practitioners, Pharmacists and Dentists Union

events.title: Kenya Space Agency is established
events.summary: The Kenya Space Agency (KSA) is a state corporation mandated to promote, coordinate and regulate space-related activities in the country. It was established in 2017 as the successor to the National Space Secretariat (NSS).

events.title: The Mombasa–Nairobi Standard Gauge Railway opens
events.summary: The Mombasa–Nairobi Standard Gauge Railway, completed in 2017, was built as the first phase of the Kenya Standard Gauge Railway. It is a standard-gauge railway (SGR) in Kenya that connects the large Indian Ocean city of Mombasa with Nairobi, the country's capital and largest city.

events.title: The National Super Alliance is formed
events.summary: The National Super Alliance (NASA), was a Kenyan political coalition of opposition centre-left parties that was formed in January 2017. The coalition was created to oppose President Uhuru Kenyatta and Deputy President William Ruto in the 2017 general elections.

events.title: Battle of Kulbiyow
events.summary: The Battle of Kulbiyow took place on 27 January 2017, when al-Shabaab militants attacked and took control of the military base and town of Kulbiyow, held by the Somali Armed Forces and the Kenya Defence Forces (KDF).

events.title: Enkare Review is founded
events.summary: Enkare Review is a Nairobi-based literary magazine established in August 2016, after initial conversations between Alexis Teyie, Troy Onyango, and Carey Baraka. In its short period of existence, it has published Taiye Selasi, Junot Díaz, Maaza Mengiste, Zukiswa Wanner, Namwali Serpell, Richard Ali, Lidudumalingani, Jericho Brown, Harriet Anena, Beverley Nambozo, Leila Aboulela, Nnedi Okorafor, Stanley Onjezani Kenani, Tendai Huchu, Kọ́lá Túbọ̀sún among others, and interviews with prolific African writer Chuma Nwokolo; and The New Yorker's editor, David Remnick.

events.title: Inaugural Kenya Standard Gauge Railway freight train launches
events.summary: Inaugural Kenya Standard Gauge Railway freight train launches.

events.title: Inaugural Kenya Standard Gauge Railway passenger train, the Madaraka Express, begins travel from Mombasa to Nairobi
events.summary: Inaugural Kenya Standard Gauge Railway passenger train, the Madaraka Express, begins travel from Mombasa to Nairobi.

events.title: 2017 Kenyan general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Kenya on 8 August 2017 to elect the President, members of the National Assembly and Senate. They coincided with the 2017 Kenyan local elections which elected Governors and representatives in the devolved governments.

events.title: The 12th Parliament opens
events.summary: The 12th Parliament of Kenya was the meeting of the legislative branch of the national government of Kenya constituted following the general election of 8 August 2017 and held its inaugural sitting on 31 August 2017. Serving during the second term of President Uhuru Kenyatta, it comprised 416 members, 349 in the National Assembly and 67 in the Senate.

events.title: the Supreme Court nullified Kenyatta's election victory and ordered that a new presidential election take place within 60 days
events.summary: the Supreme Court nullified Kenyatta's election victory and ordered that a new presidential election take place within 60 days.

events.title: October 2017 Kenyan presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Kenya on 26 October 2017 following the Supreme Court's annulment of the results of the presidential vote in the August 2017 general elections. Incumbent president and Jubilee Party candidate Uhuru Kenyatta won 98.3% of the vote, defeating Orange Democratic Movement candidate Raila Odinga, who had withdrawn weeks before the election, believing that the Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission had no intention of implementing reforms that would ensure a credible process.

events.title: Kenya's first satellite
events.summary: 1KUNS-PF (1st Kenyan University NanoSatellite-Precursor Flight) was the first Kenyan-owned satellite. The cubesat was developed and assembled by the University of Nairobi for the Kenya Space Agency, with technical support provided by Japan's Aerospace Exploration Agency.

events.title: 2018 East Africa floods
events.summary: The 2018 East Africa Floods were a natural disaster in Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Rwanda, Somalia, Djibouti, and Burundi affecting millions of people. They began when excessive rains began falling in March 2018 following a year of severe drought, leading to massive flooding, landslides, and the failure and overflow of several dams.

events.title: June - 2018 East Africa floods
events.summary: June - 2018 East Africa floods.

events.title: The handshake
events.summary: The 2018 Kenya handshake was a political truce made on the 9th of March 2018 between Kenyan President Uhuru Kenyatta and former Kenyan Prime Minister Raila Odinga. The two had been the leaders of opposing political factions amidst widespread political violence and civil unrest; they had previously faced one another in the contested 2017 Kenyan general election.

events.title: Sudan, last known male northern white rhinoceros, died in Kenya
events.summary: Sudan, last known male northern white rhinoceros, died in Kenya.

events.title: A giant crack in the ground, measuring 50 feet deep and 65 feet across, opens in or near Nairobi
events.summary: A giant crack in the ground, measuring 50 feet deep and 65 feet across, opens in or near Nairobi.

events.title: The Patel Dam near the township of Solai, Nakuru County, in the Rift Valley burst amid heavy rains, killing at least 45 people
events.summary: The Patel Dam near the township of Solai, Nakuru County, in the Rift Valley burst amid heavy rains, killing at least 45 people.

events.title: Fly-SAX Flight 102 crashes
events.summary: On 5 June 2018, Fly-SAX Flight 102, a Cessna 208B Grand Caravan operating a domestic flight in Kenya between Kitale Airport and Jomo Kenyatta International Airport, Nairobi, crashed into Elephant Hill, a peak in the Aberdare Mountains, killing all 10 people on board. The investigation ruled that the crash was a case of controlled flight into terrain, caused by the crew's decision of flying instrument flight rules at an altitude below the minimum one for that region.

events.title: At least 51 people are killed when a bus traveling from the Kenyan capital Nairobi to Kisumu veers off the road and overturns
events.summary: At least 51 people are killed when a bus traveling from the Kenyan capital Nairobi to Kisumu veers off the road and overturns.

events.title: Kenya Coast Guard Service
events.summary: The Kenya Coast Guard Service is a specialized maritime force of the Republic of Kenya, responsible for law enforcement on national waters, including on lakes and rivers, as well as in the Indian Ocean. The force is mandated to maintain maritime safety, security, pollution control and sanitation.

events.title: Macondo Literary Festival — Kenya
events.summary: Literary festival in Nairobi focused on literature of Global Africa.

events.title: 2019 Nairobi attack
events.summary: On January 15, 2019, a coordinated attack perpetrated by Al-Shabaab occurred at the DusitD2 complex in Westlands District, Nairobi, Kenya. The attack began at around 14:30 EAT (UTC+3), shortly after a suicide bomber blew himself up near the centre of the complex at a restaurant.

events.title: Death of Caroline Mwatha
events.summary: On 6 February 2019, 37-year-old Caroline Mwatha Ochieng’, a Kenyan human rights activist and founder of the Dandora Community Center (which investigates and documents cases of police killings in Dandora), went missing. Her disappearance drew a lot of attention with Kenyans mobilising on social platforms such as Twitter, under the Hashtag #FindCarolineMwatha to draw attention on the matter.

events.title: 2019 Wajir police attack
events.summary: On June 15, 2019, an al-Shabaab IED bombed a vehicle of the Kenya Police Reserve on the road between Khorof Harar and Konton in Wajir County, Kenya. Twelve police officers were killed in the attack.

events.title: Landslides in West Pokot
events.summary: On 22nd-23rd November, landslides and mudslides took place in parts of West Pokot County resulting in the death of 72 people and displacement of more than 10,000 people. Farms, food stores and livestock were swept away, and two bridges along the Kitale-Lodwar road and along Sigor road were rendered impassable, leaving road users stranded and disrupting communication networks.This followed an overnight downpour that lasted 12 hours, preventing residents from leaving their homes.
